Anna L.: FYI from the DD call this morning: two gating items for our tile payloads — 1) dynamic trace sampling rules to avoid high ingest costs for long-running inference streams, and 2) model-lineage attributes attached to spans so customers can filter traces by model/version. can we sketch an approach here?
Diego (obs): DD wants sampling to be adjustable per-resource and per-route. they suggested an attribute-based sampler; e.g., sample 100% when rw.model.stage==\"canary\" else target 5%. Also they asked for a recommended default to prevent OOMs on small accounts.
Priya S.: legal/compliance flagged sensitive prompt content in traces. we need to ensure trace payloads never include full prompt text, only redacted hashes. is there a standard attr name they accept for hashed prompts?
Theo (eng): propose adding span attributes: rw.model.name, rw.model.version, rw.model.stage, rw.inference.cold_start (bool), rw.prompt.hash. we can run a pre-export enrich step in the tracer to hash prompt content with HMAC using instance key.
Maya K.: for HW SI partners we need NVML-derived labels too (gpu.uuid, gpu.mem.total). DD asked for metric naming consistent with their metrics catalog so they can auto-map to host metrics.
Diego (obs): created a short spec: sampling rules based on attributes + a low-cost baseline 2% sample; override rules for rw.model.stage==\"canary\" -> 100%, rw.inference.latency>2000 -> 100%. Also recommend bucketing long responses into summary spans to reduce cardinality.
integrations-bot: Ticket RDW-4987 created: \"Datadog sampling + lineage attrs + redaction HMAC\" assigned to Theo (eng) and Maya K. Due: 2025-06-01.
Theo (eng): prototype OTLP exporter patch I'm testing locally — it injects rw.* attrs and calls a pre-export sampler. dropping the relevant config and a tiny patch snippet: 
```
# collector config excerpt
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http: {}
processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: rw.prompt
        action: hash
      - key: rw.instance_id
        action: insert
        value: "rdw-staging-01"
  batch: {}
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    api_key: "<DATADOG_STAGE_KEY>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes, batch]
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Theo (eng): and the tracer-side HMAC call we plan to use: `hmac_sha256(instance_secret, prompt_text)`. we store only the hex digest in rw.prompt.hash.
Priya S.: thanks. legal wants the HMAC algorithm and key storage details recorded in the partner doc. sam/anna — can we mark that as required for sign-off?
Anna L.: yes, we'll include key management notes and a line that no raw prompt text will be exported. Sam (not in thread) will need to OK.
Maya K.: about GPU metrics: I'll map nvml counters to metrics with names: redwood.gpu.util_pct, redwood.gpu.memory_bytes, redwood.gpu.power_w. DD prefers percent + bytes naming for dashboard template.
Diego (obs): for dashboards DD asked for two JSONs: 1) Tile overview (latency p50/p95, active models, gpu util by host) and 2) Incident runbook panel (top slow traces, failed inference rate). can eng produce exports?
Theo (eng): yes, I can export a draft dashboard file once we have sample metrics. I'll push to the partner bucket: gs://rdw-partners/datadog/dashboards/dd-llm-observability.json
Anna L.: DD requested a short end-to-end smoke window this week (30m) with their validation team. who can join for the smoke? Theo/Maya?
Theo (eng): available Thu 10:00 PT. I can run a small workload that exercises cold/warm cache and emits span attributes and GPU metrics.
Maya K.: I'll stand up the nvml exporter container and push test images to partner registry. need the staging DD API key from Diego.
Diego (obs): shared via secure share: <https://secrets.example/rdw-dd-stage-key> (expires in 48h).
Priya S.: also note: marketing wants a short one-liner for the marketplace tile that mentions privacy safeguards. Draft: \"Redwood Inference + Datadog: production LLM serving with lineage-aware traces and configurable sampling. No raw prompt data exported.\"
Anna L.: looks good. next steps summary: 1) Theo to finish HMAC + attribute injection and run local harness 2) Maya to publish nvml exporter image 3) Diego to schedule the DD smoke slot and share creds 4) Priya to draft legal blurb and key storage note. follow-up sync Friday 09:00 PT.
Diego (obs): please keep responses lean in this thread; we'll attach artifacts to RDW-4987. thanks.
